[env]
  DATABASE_PATH = "/data/commonplace.db"

# One machine only: SQLite has a single writer.
[http_service]
  internal_port = 3000
  force_https = true
  auto_stop_machines = "off"
  min_machines_running = 1

[mounts]
  source = "commonplace_data"
  destination = "/data"

dbs:
  - path: /data/commonplace.db
